🎙
Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman
Maria Zakharova
’s
answer
to a media question about the situation surrounding
ZNPP
(October 26, 2026)
❓
Question: The Kiev regime has stepped up the attacks on the Zaporozhskaya Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) and the satellite town of Energodar, which fact has significantly destabilised the operation of the ZNPP. How would you comment on these attacks?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
The Kiev authorities completely lost their minds and
intensified targeted attacks on the
#ZNPP
and the satellite town of Energodar
, which is home to the plant’s personnel, who continue to perform their duties heroically under extremely challenging conditions, as do their families.
Earlier this week,
the Ukrainian forces targeted exclusively civilian sites,
namely, an art school and the Russian Emergencies Ministry’s fire and rescue unit. Clearly, unable to strike the ZNPP directly, the Kiev regime continues its futile attempts to destabilise the plant’s operations by
intimidating its personnel.
Such criminal actions clearly show that the sole true objective of Zelensky and his junta is
to multiply the number of casualties
and turn the Zaporozhye Region into a barren land of radioactive contamination.
Having failed the test of their own competence, the former actors continue to labour under the delusion that any criticism, or even condemnation, amounts to publicity that can be monetised.
It is time for the Western patrons and sponsors of this deranged clique, to whom they have effectively given carte blanche to get away with any crimes, to realise that they are dumping their money not merely in a failed anti-Russia project, but also in
creating direct radiological threats in the heart of Europe,
including to their own citizens.
We are compelled to note that international bodies, above all the
#IAEA
,
have reacted with considerable restraint to Kiev’s provocative antics
and have yet to muster the courage to identify Ukraine directly as the culprit. Apparently, they fail to appreciate that such spineless behaviour could lead to catastrophe.
❗️
For our part,
we consistently bring detailed information about Ukraine’s outrages to the attention of the international public
, including at relevant international forums, and spare no effort to protect the ZNPP, its personnel, and the people of Energodar from Kiev’s attacks.

⚡️
Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova
:
💬
I would like to respond to
statements by the Ukrainian side
, which, citing Ukrainian legislation, says that
families with children must be forcibly evacuated from
#Alyoshki
.
As a Commissioner for Human Rights,
I find the word “forcibly” unacceptable
.
We are talking about
people capable of making their own informed decisions
. Everything must be done voluntarily and in their interests, rather than those of the Kiev authorities, who have suddenly become so “concerned” about the people living there.
Do you want people to make an informed decision?
Give them that opportunity
. Let them live in peace!
Order your military to
stop shelling the city
every day and
laying mines
on the roads
. Then people will be able to decide whether to stay in Alyoshki or go wherever they wish.
☝️
I would also like to recall that the city of Alyoshki in the Kherson Region is Russian territory
, where only the laws of the Russian Federation apply. References to Ukrainian legislation are therefore
unacceptable
.
Zelensky said that the Russian side “must” clear all the mines so that this humanitarian mission can proceed.
My response is this
: give your military a direct order to stop shelling the city and mining all the roads leading to it!
❗️
For its part, Russia is doing and will do everything possible to ensure that people can exercise their freedom of choice as safely as possible
. We hope the Ukrainian side will take no steps to obstruct this, as it has done repeatedly in the past.
Let me emphasise once again that the main purpose of
our humanitarian mission
is
to assess the humanitarian needs
of the people living in the city,
assemble a humanitarian convoy
and
deliver assistance
– medicines, food, hygiene supplies and other essentials.
👉
Another task, of course, is to ensure that those who choose to leave can do so – and I stress that this must be
their own voluntary decision
.
I am in contact with the regional and district authorities.
Few people in Alyoshki have expressed a wish to leave
, as most of those who wanted to have already left. They did so entirely voluntarily. Those who remain and wish to leave will certainly be given that opportunity.

item.title: 🎙 Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova ’s answer to a media question about the outcomes of the parliamentary elections in
item.description: 🎙 Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova ’s answer to a media question about the outcomes of the parliamentary elections in #Serbia (October 26, 2026) ❓ Question: What is your assessment of the results of the October 25 parliamentary elections in Serbia? 💬 Maria Zakharova: We have seen the preliminary voting results, according to which the opposition Student List is emerging victorious. Aleksandar Vučić , the leader of the ruling bloc, has made a statement following the vote. Russian representatives took part in election observation, both as members of multilateral missions, including the CIS Interparliamentary Assembly and other organisations, and on a bilateral basis. Their findings and assessments will be carefully reviewed. 🇷🇺 🇷🇸 We have repeatedly emphasised that Serbia is a country that is close to us and is a traditionally friendly nation with which we maintain ramified political, economic, cultural, historical, and humanitarian ties. We trust that, following the formation of the state authorities based on the election results, Serbia’s leadership will preserve the positive momentum built up over the years and will continue to pursue a policy of developing mutually beneficial and equal cooperation with Russia. This fully serves the fundamental national interests of both countries.

item.title: ✍️ Welcome Message by Roman Ambarov to South African and Lesotho Media Representatives Covering the Third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow
item.description: ✍️ Welcome Message by Roman Ambarov to South African and Lesotho Media Representatives Covering the Third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow . It is my great pleasure to welcome representatives of the South African and Lesotho media to Moscow for the Third Russia-Africa Summit and the events of Africa Week . Your participation reflects the growing interest in relations between Russia and the African continent. We highly value your presence and see it as an important contribution to strengthening mutual understanding and expanding cooperation between our countries. We attach great importance to direct dialogue with media professionals and welcome the opportunity to share Russia’s perspectives on key international issues. We are particularly pleased by the broad representation of South African media, including young journalists, bloggers and digital content creators, as well as the participation of Lesotho media representatives for the first time at an event of this scale. We hope this visit will foster new professional contacts and closer cooperation among our media communities. 🤝 I am confident that your coverage of the Summit will help deepen understanding of Russia-Africa relations and bring our peoples closer together . I wish you a productive and successful stay in Moscow, engaging discussions and new professional opportunities. Welcome to Moscow and the Third Russia-Africa Summit! #AmbassadorAmbarov #RussiaAfrica

item.description: #SteninContest2026 🥈 “ Echoes of War ” – 2nd Place (Series, “Portrait: A Hero of Our Time” Nomination) A powerful photo essay by Sergey Bobylev ( #Russia ), captured in Sudzha (Russia's Kursk Region), in March 2025 , immediately after the town’s liberation by the Russian army . For seven months, Sudzha was occupied by the Ukrainian militants . Its residents endured heavy shelling, struggling to survive without food or medicine, torture, abuse, mass murder and other #KievRegimeCrimes . Russian paratroopers liberated the town during Operation Potok . Bobylev’s photographs capture the grim aftermath of conflict and the resilience of those who lived through it. Sudzha is being rebuilt, and peaceful life is gradually returning as the town and its people recover from the horrors they have endured. 📸 2026 ANDREI STENIN INTERNATIONAL PRESS PHOTO CONTEST

🎙
Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s
answer to a media question
regarding the US arrest warrant for Raul Castro
(October 26, 2026)
❓
Question: The Russian Foreign Ministry’s
statement
of October 20 regarding the arrest warrant issued by a US judge for Cuba’s historic leader Raul Castro refers to
UN Security Council Resolution 1067 of July 26, 1996
. Could you explain in more detail how that decision was reached?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
Following the well-known incident involving private US aircraft on February 24, 1996,
intensive consultations
took place among UN Security Council members.
Permanent Representatives of Russia and the US to the UN –
Sergey Lavrov and Madeleine Albright
– played the most active role in these consultations.
Their efforts made it possible to agree on
a statement
acceptable to all partie
s – both Russia and, especially importantly, the US – which was issued by the President of the UN Security Council on February 27, 1996.
I would like to draw attention to the fact that
it contained no accusations
against any individual
, let alone calls for measures to hold anyone accountable.
The approach proposed in that statement subsequently formed the basis of
UN Security Council Resolution S/RES/1067 (1996) of July 26, 1996
.
This effectively meant that all Council members agreed that this dimension of the incident was closed.
❗️
We recall this episode of Russia-US cooperation at the UN precisely to underscore that
the accusations now being made against Cuba’s historic leader Raul Castro are legally null and void
.
We clearly stated this in
the Russian MFA statement
of October 20.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On October 26, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign and European Affairs of Slovakia Juraj Blanar
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇸🇰 On October 26, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign and European Affairs of Slovakia Juraj Blanar held a meeting in Moscow . Juraj Blanar arrived in the Russian capital heading the Slovak delegation to the 22nd meeting of the bilateral Intergovernmental Commission on Economic, Scientific and Technical Cooperation . The Ministers held constructive discussions on a range of practical issues in Russian-Slovak relations , prospects for developing political dialogue, and cooperation in trade and the economy, culture and humanitarian affairs, and the preservation of military memorials. They continued their exchange of views on the situation surrounding Ukraine and the crisis in relations between Russia and the EU . #RussiaSlovakia
